items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Jelly Roll and some man there was named Al somebody, wearing a big diamond ring

ctx.x: At the Rhythm Club in front of everybody. Read that. So I read it. He said, go home and take your tuxedo off and then come back at 8 o'clock here. Yes, sir.

I did it and so Jelly Roll and some man there was named Al somebody, wearing a big diamond ring, and Jelly Roll opened up, cursing the chick out, come up here you so and so: and sing a song, and don't you rush the tempo and you hear what I said, and she was crying. Get up there now and he started playing one of them gut bucket things--take that mute and put it in that half pocket and I did just that. I stayed there and Jelly Roll Morton and he was -- those poor women, was in awful shape and the gangsters come in,…

So then it seemed like overnight, seeing that thing happen like it happen -- something happen and wouldn't nobody come to work. Can't go over there now, little later, little later, then we went to work and some guys come in there and Jelly Roll Morton say come on, let's get behind the piano and then make it out the back door and that's what we did and then
